items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: and we were always good friends, buddies

ctx.x: I mean now, where did Bob Fuller come from?

Well, I was asked by the club I belonged to, oldest Negre the only musicians' club in the country, and he was a member of that club for years, and last time I saw Bob was after the war, and we were always good friends, buddies, and Bob had left -- after he left the dancing school, he had a job for years playing on 125th Street, called the Dreamland Dance School, a dance school where they had these hostesses like, and anyway in all Bob was there about ten or 12 years. So when that place closed up because the…
controlling it, he taken an examination, and last time I saw him he was a turnkey at the city jail. He worked for the police department.
